info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Recurrence API

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: The start date for when to get the list of recurrences. The startDateTime and endDateTime can be no more than 30 days apart.

params.name: endDateTime
params.description: The end date for when to get the list of recurrences. The startDateTime and endDateTime can be no more than 30 days apart.

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: The start date for when to get the recurrence and aggregate its data. The startDateTime and endDateTime can be no more than 30 days apart.

params.name: endDateTime
params.description: The end date for when to get recurrence and aggregate its data. The startDateTime and endDateTime can be no more than 30 days apart.

items.docs: Gets the recurrence information for the specified recurrence ID.
